newsitem.title: USA: Gymboree to repurchase up to $30 mln stk.
newsitem.headline: Gymboree to repurchase up to $30 mln stk.

text.p: Gymboree Corp Friday said its board authorized a repurchase program of its common stock for up to $30 million to be bought on the open market.
As of February 2, 1997, Gymboree had approximately 26 million shares outstanding.

"The board's decision reflects its confidence in Gymboree's business and prospects and the fact that it believes that the range in which Gymboree's shares have recently traded does not reflect its true potential," said Gary White, president and chief executive officer. "It is also consistent with our objective of enhancing shareholder value."

Gymboree designs, manufactures, and retails pparel and accessories for children from birth to seven years of age. It operates 366 stores which includes 361 stores in 48 states in the U.S. and five stores in Canada. The company also offers directed parent-child developmental play programs at over 375 franchised centers.
